        billed_c = ogc_s*bf(i)
        churn_c = billed_c*s['ogc']
        rev_c = (billed_c-churn_c)*P
        ogc_s -= churn_c
        billed_a = a_s*af(i)
        churn_a = billed_a*s['ac']
        rev_a = (billed_a-churn_a)*PA

        # compute scales with og_c (active C ~ og_c + small tail)

afrac = {0:0.35,1:0.30,2:0.29,3:0.05,4:0.28}
def bf(i): return bill_frac.get(i, 0.225)
def af(i): return afrac.get(i, 0.23)
horizons = {1:'wk40(d280)',4:'wk43(d301)',12:'wk51(d357)',26:'wk65(d455)'}

# Decelerating churn-at-billing: start hi, decay toward lo (concentration). compute=$16/C/wk.
def run(ogc_bill_hi, ogc_bill_lo, ac, fixed, comp_per_c, label):
    cash=cash0; ogc=og_c0; a=a0; out={}
    for wk in range(1,27):
        i=wk-1
        frac = wk/26.0
        ogc_bill = ogc_bill_hi*(1-frac)+ogc_bill_lo*frac  # decel
        billed_c=ogc*bf(i); churn_c=billed_c*ogc_bill
        rev_c=(billed_c-churn_c)*P; ogc-=churn_c
        billed_a=a*af(i); churn_a=billed_a*ac
        rev_a=(billed_a-churn_a)*PA; a-=churn_a
        rev=rev_c+rev_a+200
        compute=comp_per_c*ogc+500
        cash+=rev-(compute+fixed)
        if wk in horizons: out[wk]=cash
    print('%-6s' % label, {horizons[h]:round(out[h]) for h in horizons}, '| endOGC=%d'%ogc)
    return out
